post.caption:
12 rejections this year. Did you stop knocking on His door? 🤍

“So do not weaken and do not grieve.” (3:139)

A closed door on earth is not a closed door with Allah. Today at Maghrib: pray. Tomorrow: apply again. 🤲
post.youtube_title: 12 rejections this year. Did you stop knocking on His door? 🤍 #islam #hope

verses.text: “So do not weaken and do not grieve.”

captions: 4:12 p.m. Line 4. Everyone on their phone.
After number five, you stopped praying.
Then the train stops. The tunnel goes dark.
In the black window: just you. Tired.
You get off one stop early. The park.
The leaves fall. The tree is still standing.
You face the qibla. And you knock again.
No job yet. But you are not forgotten.
